name: Usui Kaoruko
source:
As Vice Principal at Central Tanegashima High, Usui holds high expectations for education. She usually puts students first, but can be rather hard on those that do not match her perception of an ideal student. She feuds with the Robotics Club over its funding.

[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.com/ROBOTICSNOTES/]Spike Chunsoft's Official ROBOTICS;NOTES Website[/url]]
